plan.display_headline: 6 promises protected. A recovery you can inspect.

proposal.headline: Secure Harbor Supply to protect all six orders
proposal.diagnosis: Current stock covers SO-2041, SO-2043, SO-2045 partially; remaining demand requires timely inbound. Harbor Supply offers lead times ≤24h for all SKUs.
proposal.tradeoffs: Slightly higher unit cost than alternatives but guarantees on‑time delivery. Uses full budget cushion while keeping cash above floor.
proposal.next_steps: Place purchase drafts for the three offers. Allocate incoming units to each order per arrival schedule. Verify receipt timestamps before respective due dates.

plan.operator_brief: Review the proposed purchase drafts and confirm supplier availability before proceeding.

proposal.headline: Buy Summit FILTER packs to meet SO-2041 deadline
proposal.diagnosis: SO-2041 needs 80 FILTER units due in 12h; only 20 on hand + 80 verified inbound = 100 available, but inbound timing uncertain. O-SM-F delivers in 6h with 20-unit packs.
proposal.tradeoffs: Higher per-unit cost than Northline but faster delivery ensures SO-2041 coverage. No other SKUs at immediate risk given current stock and lead times.
proposal.next_steps: Confirm O-SM-F pack availability and lead time. Allocate 40 units from purchase to SO-2041. Monitor receipt against SO-2041 due time.
